text:
sam: deploy-bot flagged a p95 regression in canary for v3.6.2 ~5m ago. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/xyz. Suggest we pause rollout and consider rollback.
deploy-bot: automated check: canary p95=730ms (baseline 200ms). error +1.7%. Cause hint: kernel flag toggle -> kvcache churn. Recommendation: AUTO-ROLLBACK in 120s unless operator intervenes.
kai: I'm oncall. Any chance this is a telemetry blip? Correlating traces?
maria: logs show GC stalls around same window on several hosts. stack traces point at kvcache refresh.
sam: sounds like the kernel-flag path. Don't continue rollout. Plan: operator-led staged rollback to v3.6.1, observe, then decide about full revert.
ashley: ok. Two things: 1) do we let auto-rollback run or override and do manual staged rollback? 2) who posts external comms?
sam: override auto, manual rollback. I'll own comms. Ash, please execute rollback and paste commands.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback timer paused by operator override at T+110s. Manual operator action required.
kai: Recommend staged percentages: 10% -> 50% -> 100%, wait 3 min between steps, abort if errors jump >0.5% absolute. Keep deploy-bot hook open.
maria: I'll verify v3.6.1 checksums and watch for GC patterns during shifts.
ashley: Commands I'll run:
```
# pin service to older version
redwoodctl service pin --service inference-api --version v3.6.1 --reason "canary p95 regression"
# shift traffic slice
redwoodctl traffic shift --service inference-api --from v3.6.2 --to v3.6.1 --percent 10 --wait 180s
```
Executing now.
[2025-11-12T13:14:22Z] Action: pin inference-api -> v3.6.1 (operator ashley)
[2025-11-12T13:14:25Z] Traffic shift: 10% -> v3.6.1
[2025-11-12T13:17:30Z] Observed p95 drop: 730ms -> 240ms in canary slice
[2025-11-12T13:17:31Z] Traffic shift: 50% -> v3.6.1
kai: good. keep 3min window. if error rate > baseline +0.5% abort and fallback to v3.6.0 and open incident.
maria: Checksums for v3.6.1 verified in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. No integrity issues. GC stalls gone on the pinned hosts.
sam: I drafted a short support blurb: "Canary rolled back to v3.6.1 due to latency regression. Monitoring. No customer data exposure." @support please escalate if you see user reports. Add to release-notes/rollback-notes.md.
ashley: Completed 100% rollback at 13:24Z. Final canary metrics: p95 235ms, error rate within baseline. Created rollback PR: https://git.redwood/rollbacks/PR-412
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback disabled for this release until postmortem is complete (operator: sam). Suggest localized regression tests on v3.6.2 before reattempt.
sam: Next actions: 1) block v3.6.2 in release calendar, 2) create postmortem ticket with perf traces + kernel flag diff, 3) prepare patch release v3.6.3 if root cause found, 4) update public release notes to reflect rollback and user impact.
kai: I'll set up the postmortem meeting and add oncall rotation.
maria: I'll start delta analysis between v3.6.1 and v3.6.2 focusing on kernel flags and quant kernel changes.
ashley: Closing thread. If deploy-bot recommends rollback again, re-open thread and ping me.
oncall-bot: Reminder: manual rollback requires incident ticket. Created INC-2025-084.
sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
